commentary.narrative_context: The Borsuk-Ulam theorem is a fundamental result in topology. It asserts that any continuous function from an n-sphere to n-dimensional Euclidean space maps some pair of antipodal points to the same image point. It is a pillar of algebraic topology with consequences for many areas of mathematics.
